title: potentilla verna f. oblongifolia
intro: Potentilla verna f. oblongifolia, commonly known as Alpine Cinquefoil, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can aid in soothing digestive issues and alleviating pain. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Cinquefoil include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, making it useful for wound healing and treating infections. The bioactive constituents of Potentilla verna f. oblongifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
